services.name: Airboat Tours
services.desc: Crystal River and the surrounding area is known as the Nature Coast. This name comes from the miles of undeveloped coastline that makes this area home to an incredible variety of wildlife. Our airboat tours are fun and exciting way to see this beautiful landscape and the animals that call it home. On any given day, we see manatees, bottlenose dolphins, otters, and bald eagles while traversing the backcountry creeks and marshes that border the open Gulf of Mexico. With so much to see there’s no doubt that you will enjoy your time on the water with Capt John. Our trips are all inclusive with high quality fishing tackle, fishing license, bait, and bottled water included in the price of trip.
